card.name: Just before US place names
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words right before a US city or town name, often in citations and place lists. Also the start of place names like Beltsville and Belzoni.

modes.label: Citation before publisher city
modes.description: A period or bracket in a reference, just before the place of publication.

modes.label: Linking word before town
modes.description: Like, in or and placed right before a town or city name.
modes.example: in small theaters in towns<< like>> Greenwood and Greenville.

modes.label: Start of place name
modes.description: The first piece of a town name split into parts.

card.plain: It fires at the spot where a US city or town name is about to appear, especially in book citations.
